dimensions.measure: Follows the actual writing request and its negative constraints

levels.2: Correct form/topic but misses minor constraints
levels.3: All explicit constraints followed with meaningful craft
levels.4: Precisely serves request with zero structural/negative-constraint loss

dimensions.measure: Each lyrical clause makes sense and connects causally

levels.2: Mostly logical with occasional unclear turns
levels.3: Coherent event/argument/voice from beginning to end
levels.4: Every technique serves a causal or emotional purpose

dimensions.measure: End families and internal rhymes support syntax

levels.0: Mechanical or no intentional sound relation
levels.3: Varied internal/end patterns without compromised meaning
levels.4: Complex, natural and expressive rhyme movement

dimensions.measure: Humanly intelligible breath, stresses and beat phrasing

levels.0: Unperformable syllable piles or prose paragraphs
levels.2: Readable rhythm with some distinct accents
levels.3: Effective speed contrast, stress and breathing resets
levels.4: Fluid expressive speed changes and naturally timed punchlines

dimensions.measure: The user receives a genuine completed song/verse

levels.0: Fragment, unfinished ending or irrelevant padding
levels.1: Bare sketch or very short sections
levels.3: All requested sections/length and clean ending
levels.4: Extended work feels necessary; every movement earns its place

dimensions.measure: Repetition occurs only when musically and narratively useful

levels.0: Empty repeated padding or mandatory hook where forbidden
levels.2: Clear repeatable hook appropriate to form
levels.3: Memorable refrain anchored in title/scene, meaning evolves
levels.4: Hook or hookless form exactly chosen for expressive effect

dimensions.measure: Specific nouns, setting and sensory consequences

levels.4: Fresh images interact as a coherent system

dimensions.measure: Goals, opposition, moves and consequences progress

levels.1: Some motion but no change in stakes
levels.3: Decisions have clear consequences and satisfying arc
levels.4: Layered escalating arc with earned reversal and no filler

dimensions.measure: Emotions follow from action, subtext and relationship

levels.0: Unmotivated sentiment or instant inspirational turn
levels.3: Concrete choices create authentic emotional evolution
levels.4: Restraint and detail yield an earned, original emotional resolution

dimensions.measure: When requested, jokes or rebuttals have a target and payoff

levels.0: Random insults or stated punchline explanations
levels.3: Sharp subject-linked reversals with rhythmic landing
levels.4: Layered misdirection, callbacks and coherent sustained escalation

dimensions.measure: Independent diction, perspective and subject vocabulary

levels.0: Borrowed lines, recognizable hooks, repeated stock metaphors
levels.3: Consistent distinctive original voice and scene
levels.4: Highly original while fully detached from reference words, title and imagery

dimensions.measure: A requested correction changes the failing observable

levels.1: Some edits but the defect survives
levels.3: Specific defect repaired; earlier constraints retained
levels.4: Repair strengthens craft and meaning without collateral regression

audience: editorial and independent evaluation, not model self certification
promotionPolicy: No user historical item or synthetic instructor draft is accepted as weight-trainable without independent human QC, rights/privacy review, and absence of high-risk source overlap.
